verdict.summary_en: Rush-service offer from Karton Nowak to Soony Interactive GmbH dated 21.11.2026, valid 24 h. Item 1: rush print of sleeves, leaflets and posters up to 50,000 pcs, ready 36 h from print-ready file, at Annex A price +35%. Item 2: 8,000 pcs of CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6 from overrun stock, loaded within 4 h of order, at Annex A price. Transport by Warta Trans, Poznań–Hamburg about 9 h. Refers to a separate notice of planned downtime.
red_flags: Offer is valid for only 24 hours from 21.11.2026.
Item 1 carries a 35% surcharge over the Annex A price.
The offer refers to a separate notice of planned downtime, which is not part of this document and may affect the lead times.
No absolute prices are given, only references to Annex A, so the totals cannot be checked from this document.
Item 2 is overrun stock and is quoted at 8,000 pcs, which may not match the buyer's required quantity.
observations: Clean, typed, bilingual (Polish/English) PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
